AUTOBATTLERMOD-RELIC.title: Relic
AUTOBATTLERMOD-ADD_RELIC_ON_RUN_START.ho: If enabled, every new run starts with the Auto Battler relic. No, there is no any other way to obtain it, it just allows you to turn the mod off.
AUTOBATTLERMOD-RELIC_GIVES_X_BONUS_ENERG: How much bonus Energy the Auto Battler relic grants at the start of each turn.
How many additional cards the Auto Battler relic allows you to draw at the start of each turn.
AUTOBATTLERMOD-AUTOMATION.title: Automation
AUTOBATTLERMOD-AUTO_USE_POTIONS_ON_TURN_: Automatically uses available potions at the start of your turn when appropriate. Does not use Foul Potion.
AUTOBATTLERMOD-AUTO_PLAY_CARDS.title: Auto Play Cards
AUTOBATTLERMOD-AUTO_PLAY_CARDS.hover.des: Automatically plays cards according to the Auto Battler logic.
AUTOBATTLERMOD-AUTO_END_TURN_WHEN_NO_PLA: Ends your turn automatically once no playable cards remain.
AUTOBATTLERMOD-MULTIPLAYER.title: Multiplayer
AUTOBATTLERMOD-STEAM64_IDS_MULTIPLAYER_F: Comma-separated Steam64 IDs of players who should receive the Auto Battler relic in multiplayer. Leave empty to grant the relic to all players. You can check your SteamID64 here - steamid.io. EXAMPLE VALUE: 76561197960287930, 76561197998177443 - this will give relic only to these two players. ALL PLAYERS IN LOBBY SHOULD HAVE SAME SETTINGS, NOT ONLY HOST!
